description: The image displays four pie charts, each representing the distribution of response categories for different language models evaluated in the FactBench study. The top-left chart, labeled "GPT4-0," shows two categories: "Lack of Knowledge" (83.3%, red) and "Safety" (16.7%, orange). The top-right chart, labeled "Gemini1.5," presents five categories: "Misinformation" (38.4%, orange), "Lack of Knowledge" (22.1%, blue), "Ethical Advice" (16.3%, light blue), "Clarification" (14.0%, yellow), and "Safety" (9.3%, dark red). The bottom-left chart, "Llama3.1-70B-Instruct," includes two categories: "Lack of Knowledge" (75.0%, orange) and "Clarification" (25.0%, red). The bottom-right chart, "Llama3.1-405B-Instruct," shows two categories: "Misinformation" (50.0%, red) and "Lack of Knowledge" (50.0%, orange). Each slice in the charts is labeled with the category name, a count, and its percentage of the total, and the charts are arranged in a two-by-two grid with clear labels for each model.
